observations.cosmic_density: The v09 field remains above the closing invitation. The Nexus shows crisp cyan and ember filaments, with halos tied to specific junctions.
observations.dark_voids: The closing artwork has an open dark type bed. The strands feather into the GitHub dark canvas at the perimeter.
observations.luminous_clusters: Successive bright cyan and ember cores grow a surrounding halo and leave a small afterglow. Both paths were inspected at 255 px.
observations.vertical_continuity: The banner and two text transitions carry the v09 blue and orange web. The final panel echoes their descending motion along both margins.
observations.phone_legibility: Both lines remain readable at 255 px in the encoded GIF and its PNG. Centered Instrument Sans makes Build with me the stronger line and stays steady.
observations.fibonacci_structure: Earlier panels retain 21 frames at 130 ms. The Nexus uses 34 frames at 80 ms. The banner retains its Fibonacci curve.
observations.handoff_ontology: The cyan lane carries the invitation to explore and the ember lane carries the invitation to collaborate. The linked graphic opens the public work.
observations.continuous_motion: The cyan and ember paths rise and fade in turn across a seamless, infinite 2.72-second loop. The still poster carries the same wording.
observations.palette: Cold blue and ember match the avatar and upper panels. Off-white and warm white set two distinct lines of stable text.
observations.pinned_handoff: Illuminated knots progress downward on both sides toward Pinned. The reviewed poster and GIF have identical framing and type.
